entry.author: New Zealand Trade and Enterprise
entry.summary:
Getting your channel strategy right is crucial in a new export market. Channel expert and NZTE Beachhead advisor Becky Lloyd explains what to consider when selecting a channel, the different roles channels can play, and how having data and measurement in place can help you make informed decisions.

Learn more: https://my.nzte.govt.nz/article/20251013-get-insights-from-expert-global-business-advisors
